interpretation: Gaps are separated by remedy, because the cost of each differs by orders of magnitude. A missing coordinate is fixed with a pin drop; an approximate one needs a survey; a degraded camera needs maintenance on capital already spent; genuinely uncovered ground needs procurement. The journey-implied gaps are the strongest evidence here: a position that real investigations keep needing, and where nothing was seen, is an evidence-backed case for the next camera rather than an opinion about it.
